name: David
blurb: David was a shepherd boy who trusted God more than he feared a giant. God chose him to be king of Israel, and he wrote many of the Psalms. Jesus was born from David's family, just as God promised.
bullets: Beat Goliath with a sling, a stone, and faith in God
Wrote songs to God, like Psalm 23
Made big mistakes, but always came back to God

name: Goliath
blurb: Goliath was a giant warrior from the Philistines, over nine feet tall. For forty days he dared Israel's army to fight him, and everyone was afraid - until a boy named David stepped up.
bullets: Wore heavy armor and carried a huge spear
Laughed at David for being small
Shows that God's power is bigger than any giant

name: Jonathan
blurb: Jonathan was King Saul's son and David's best friend. Even though he could have been king, he loved David and protected him from his own father.
bullets: Gave David his own robe and sword as a sign of friendship
Warned David when Saul wanted to hurt him
Showed what a true, selfless friend looks like
